I should never have bet on that dice game...
I've been thinking of getting a pet. It would be nice, don't you think?

Ladi dadi dadi dada.
I hope the children are doing alright back home. It's been so long now since I last saw them...
When we get back home I think I'm going to pick up a new hobby.
I think my boot needs mending.
Ah, to feel the cool relief of mist on my face... I was a fool to leave that post behind.
I wonder what discoveries tomorrow will bring. Those Whitebeards don't know what they're missing!
I could never remain stationed at just one excavation for months. Us Redbeards are meant to explore!
The Whitebeards will be jealous when they hear of our success, I'm sure!
Then again, the heat isn't too bad!
I don't care much for those smokepuff mushrooms myself. Only fit for asksvin food, really!
I saw someone run around in just their underpants and some belts, seemed nice and cool...
Those siblings had the right idea. Imagine being off on your very own business venture in a cool forest!
I wonder what we'll find out here. Surely it must be worth it.
I wish I could have a nice, cool bath.
What do you suppose we'll find out here?
We sure hit those charred hard yesterday, didn't we?

Hugin
Munin

Kraa! A sad memory lingers here... A faint echo in the air... Once these rang for joy to celebrate his passing but now he cannot bear the sound nor the reminder. If you seek to bring him give them voice once more.
Kraa! Poor pickings here. Empty skulls scoured clean by the flames. Barely a trace of memory left…
Well met little swordling! Look around you this is the Waste of the Emerald Flame… This is the end of all pride the fire that consumes itself… Tread carefully!
Kraa! I bring a message from the Allfather. Honor is forged in flame. Strike hard upon the anvil spare not the steel!
Kraahaha! A fellow carrion bird! Look at you picking over these poor dead remains…
Hmmm... How do you yet live warrior? Perhaps you have found your element here in the furnace? Curious...
This is a place of transformation. Certain creatures find a new purpose here, becoming something more than they once were. Are you one of these creatures, I wonder?
Kraa! Those who first ventured here did not know about the underground thieves. If they had known, they would certainly have chosen better places to build their homesteads.
Watch these lands for memorials in the honour of the warriors who came before you. They may bestow a boon upon you, should you prove yourself worthy in their eyes.

Long before the Allfather summoned you, others were tasked to guard this world. Even though many years have gone by since their passing, they still can't seem to find peace. Be kind, and do not disturb them.
Kraa! Strange folk dwell here, created from the very evil itself...
Long ago, others attempted to sail to these lands. It appears they made it here, but that there was no way for them to make the return journey...

Kraa! Well met, wanderer… I am Munin, brother to Hugin. I bring greetings from the Allfather. His eye sees through mine, I carry his words beneath my tongue. Keep his ways and I will come to you again…
Kraa! All eyes are on this one. Big eyes, little eyes, eyes from above and eyes from below. Even the trees have eyes…
Still you live, warrior? I had hoped for some little snack from your corpse, some morsel of carrion… Still, the Allfather will be pleased.
Are you lost in the fog, warrior? I see things your eyes once knew, paths you trod and faces you loved. Poor warrior…
Kraa! Do not forget your quest, wanderer! Remember why the Allfather sent you here. The Forsaken Ones must be destroyed. Remember!

Ah, you have grown into a fine warrior! As a courtesy, I should tell you that when you die, we have agreed that Hugin will have your left eye as a treat and I will have your right. But we wish you well!
Kraa! Serve the Allfather well and he has given me leave to restore your memories. Do you remember the life you had before this one? It yet remembers you...
I had not thought you would survive so long… But guard against pride, friend. Battlefields are banquets to me, I know how all great warriors end...

Kraa! Hear me now, I'll riddle you no longer. I am great Munin, the treasure-house of memory. I sit on the left shoulder of the Allfather and do his bidding in the ten worlds. I have seen many great warriors rise and fall but you are among the greatest. Know that Oden himself is watching you...
Kraa! The Allfather sends tidings! He waits on your word to send the great bridge. Kill the Forsaken Ones and clear the way!
Valkyrie
Journey to Valhalla
